en: Color postcard showing a crowded seaside bathing area with a woman sitting on rocks and a beach ball in the foreground. Behind the water rise two modern high‑rise hotel towers. The reverse is in Romanian with a 40 B POSTA ROMANA stamp (Densuș) and a circular postmark dated 12.8.74. Printed caption identifies the scene as the Diana and Atena hotels in Saturn resort, Romania.
